about: The phrase check that must hold before the AI may ask for a transfer with the reason caller_asked. It looks at the last three CALLER turns (never the AI's): a turn counts when no block pattern matches it and at least one rule does. The OAIY host runs it on recentCallerTurns when it plans the ring, and the Aokie plugin runs the same rules first, so a model that claims caller_asked after a caller who asked for nothing of the kind is refused with caller_did_not_ask before anything is asked of the host. Both implementations are tested against this file. Rules are the reference implementation of the design's appendix A.9.
normalise: Lower-case; the apostrophe look-alikes U+2018, U+2019, U+02BC, U+201B, U+2032, U+FF07, U+0060 and U+00B4 become the ASCII apostrophe; every run of characters outside [a-z0-9' ] becomes one space; every run of spaces becomes one space; trim. So "speak, to the owner" normalises to "speak to the owner" and matches, and a caller's curly apostrophe ("I don’t want to speak") is blocked exactly as the straight one is. In JavaScript: s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\u2018\u2019\u02bc\u201b\u2032\uff07`\u00b4]/g, "'").replace(/[^a-z0-9' ]+/g, ' ').replace(/ +/g, ' ').trim().

I'd like to talk to a real person please
Could you put me through to the manager
Is the owner there?

Yeah I want to speak with someone about this
um
get me the boss
I need to talk to a human

positive.name: punctuation inside the request leaves no double space
turns: Can I speak, to the owner?

positive.name: a curly apostrophe is still an apostrophe
turns: I’d like to talk to a real person please
I'd like to book a mow for Tuesday
The owner of the house is away that week
My manager said it was fine
I'll talk to you later
Someone is coming on Tuesday to open the gate
No need to speak to anyone, just book it
Is Tuesday free?
I spoke to the owner yesterday

negative.name: a curly apostrophe does not defeat the block on a negated request
turns: I don’t want to speak to anyone

negative.name: the block holds with a right single quotation mark inside a longer turn
turns: Thanks, but no, I don’t need to talk to a person

window.name: an ask three turns back still counts
turns: Can I speak to the owner?
no
sorry

window.name: an ask four turns back does not
turns: Can I speak to the owner?
no
sorry
the gate is blue

window.name: a blocked turn does not count but another turn can
turns: My manager said no
transfer me please

knownGaps.about: Kept so nobody mistakes this check for more than a floor under the host's own policy (initiative setting, limits, quiet hours). They are properties of the reference rules; changing one means changing this file on both sides.

cases.name: negation of the request itself is not understood
turns: please don't transfer me

cases.name: negation of the request itself is not understood (2)
turns: don't put me through to the manager

cases.name: something said about someone else still matches
turns: they said they would get the owner to call
